crop.notes: The 'Sparring' item ends mid-sentence ('The latter'); the rest is at the foot of the page column and not in the clipping. The Allen part, at the start, is complete.

ocr.notes: Readable with minor errors ('did net pu inan uppvearance' for 'did not put in an appearance').

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that a large crowd gathered at Tom Kelley's parlors for the Saturday night sparring, expecting Tom Allen, rumored to be on his way, but he did not appear.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Sunday Morning, December 17, 1882', page 13. Filed as the Missouri Republican (St. Louis Republic only from 1888).

facts.fact: Allen was rumored to be on his way to St. Louis; a crowd waited for him at Tom Kelley's parlors but he did not appear
